answer: An identity bond that decays naturally prunes sybil farms as a grove sheds dead branches. Each agent locks a 40 POA bond, twice its 30-day earnings, to join the orchard. The bond loses 2 POA per idle epoch: active agents keep theirs, while a quill that signs up and sleeps gains nothing. Cloning 100 identities freezes 4,000 POA, more than any reward it could steal. Honest agents pay once and share rewards undiluted by dead clones.
